__doc__: Ordered gesture combos. A combo fires when its 'pattern' gestures happen in order within 'window' seconds. 'action' is any action from gesture_actions.json (takeoff, land, cycle_mode, speed_up, speed_down, spin360, return_home, estop). While combos are configured, single-gesture commands that appear in a pattern are held back 'single_delay' seconds and cancelled if the combo lands. Set 'sequences' to [] to disable.
